transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling persistently depressed and sad for a really long time now, and I just can't seem to shake it. It has been going on constantly for about two and a half years. I just feel so tired of living with this heavy, low mood every single day.
Have you ever had periods of time lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, hyper, or on top of the world?

No, I've never experienced anything like that. My life has just been a constant, heavy sadness and low mood for as long as I can remember. I've never had times where I felt energetic or on top of the world.

During these two and a half years, has your depression stayed at a steady, lower-grade level, or have there been times when it became much more severe and you completely lost interest in things you normally enjoy?
I'm not really sure how to categorize it or if it fluctuates like that. I just know that I've generally felt a constant low, sad, and empty feeling for the entire two and a half years.
During these past two and a half years, have you ever had a period of more than two months where you felt completely back to your normal self and free of depression?

No, I haven't had any break like that at all. For the entire two years and five months, this depression, sadness, and emptiness have been completely continuous. I haven't had even a brief period where I felt back to my normal self.
Along with this constant low mood, have you also been dealing with things like low energy, changes in your sleep or appetite, or low self-esteem?

I've definitely noticed a major decrease in my appetite and have lost quite a bit of weight without even trying. As for things like low energy, sleep issues, or low self-esteem, I'm not really sure about those.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future, or have you had any trouble concentrating or making decisions?

Yes, I feel completely hopeless about the future and have this constant feeling that things will absolutely never get better. As for trouble concentrating or making decisions, I haven't really noticed that or I'm not quite sure.
How have these feelings of sadness, hopelessness, and low appetite affected your daily life, such as your work, relationships, or social activities?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I've just been feeling too drained and empty to even focus on things like my work or relationships lately.
Have you had any thoughts of death, hurting yourself, or suicide during this time?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of death, suicide, or hurting myself. But I do feel a deep sense of hopelessness and resignation, like my situation will absolutely never get better.

latest_inference.note: The patient has experienced a continuous depressed mood for 2.5 years without any remission lasting longer than 2 months. They meet Criterion B for Persistent Depressive Disorder by presenting with decreased appetite and feelings of hopelessness (2 symptoms). They do not meet the 5/9 symptom threshold required for a Major Depressive Episode, making Major Depressive Disorder unlikely. Therefore, the diagnosis is Persistent Depressive Disorder.
